desc:
DAILY REWARDS HAS BEEN ADDED! NEW SECRET GUN!

LIKE THE GAME FOR MORE UPDATES 👍

Welcome to Protect the Stash💰

You are ILLEGALLY printing money with your friends but someone reported you to the police! You must fight the government every day to protect your printer. You can upgrade the printer to print more money and purchase base defenses like turrets as well as purchase better weapons. Do you think you have what it takes to fend off the GOVERNMENT? 

How to play:
Protect the illegal cash printer 💸
Fight off cops 👮
Buy better guns ☠️
Survive the longest ❤️

Console and Mobile SUPPORTED! 📱🎮
